items.title: 現在のアークナイツ: エンドフィールドは、第 2 リージョンがリリースされたときの WuWa と同じ年齢 (224 日) です。これまでの試合についてどう思いますか？エンドフィールドは7か月半経ってもまだ期待できるだろうか？
items.sourceType: 海外Redditフォーラム ガチャゲー最前線
items.scriptOutline:
【動画・記事の完全論説・網羅的詳細】：
It's all too common nowadays for disastrous launches and gacha discussions to inevitably angle towards WuWa's 2.0 update as the exemplar of a game bouncing back. Is the breakthrough surrounding Rinascita somehow a given industry norm, or was it an exception? Do you think that newer games like Endfield and NTE are heading in the right direction and keeping pace with their contemporaries in Hoyo/Kuro? Or have they failed to meet expectations? This is not a post about WuWa, but rather an inquiry on the grace period gacha players are willing to show leniency to these companies while they address core issues. Personally I think that sentiment such as "next region will be better trust me bro" is ridiculous. This is just goalpost moving and a form of toxic positivity that only serves the purpose of buying/stalling time for the developers, despite likely not having earned any tangible goodwill.    submitted by    /u/Swords-2-Plowshares   [link]   [個のコメント]
